answer: An operator copying one text across 79 aliases therefore pays for 79 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the quartz hash is stored at intake, the horizon graph groups the endorsements and the ivory audit exposes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
